Roll.WithGear: Roll with this item as an asset
Roll.Question: Question

Combat.Title: Combat flow

Combat.RollInjuryHint: Skip the phases and roll the wound directly
Combat.SetOpponent: Use the selected token as the opponent

Gear.CustomSentence: Custom sentence (used only when the fields above are empty)

Wealth.TallyHint: Wealth tally (gambling): five marks climb a Wealth level

Spell.MaiHint: base from species or type, +1 per magical sentence tag, max +3
Spell.RequiresChaos: More than one aspect or type requires the Chaos base.
Spell.MaxAxes: A spell can have at most three aspects, three types, and five axes in total.

Quest.Hint: Click tally boxes to track Plan, Location and Countdown. Completing Plan or Location reduces the Countdown by one.
Quest.TallyHint: A full Plan eases the resolution roll by 1; each missing mark hinders it by 1.
Quest.AugurLinked: Quest {name} linked to its Augur record.
Quest.AugurHint: Drop an Augur quest journal on the sheet to track it here.

Barter.NeedsRoll: At or above your Wealth: Wealth check

Coins.Hint: Adds coins as a currency. Coins are tallies toward the next Wealth level: 10 coins take you from Wealth 0 to 1, 100 from 1 to 2, and so on. Not part of the SRD.

Welcome.Title: Welcome to Tag & Tally
Welcome.Body:
Create a Character, add tags on the Tags tab, and press Roll. Set a scene level in the Scene configuration so rolls default to it.

The Sparks, Combat flow and Party overview buttons live in the token controls. Macros are available under game.tagandtally.macros.

Coins.Hint: Coins mode: coins are tallies toward the next Wealth level (10, then 100, then 1000…). Cashing out trades one Wealth level for its coins.
Coins.Climb: Spend coins to reach the next Wealth level
Coins.CashOut: Cash out: drop one Wealth level and receive its coins
Coins.ReceiveCoins: Receive the coin price from the merchant
Coins.MerchantBroke: The merchant is broke and cannot buy anything.
Coins.BarterHint: Coins mode: buying pays the coin price, cashing out Wealth levels when your purse is short. Selling rolls the Wealth check: success pays the full price, failure half. The merchant cashes out their own Wealth to pay and goes broke when it runs out.
Coins.SoldForHalf: sells {item} to {merchant} for {coins} coins, half its worth.
Coins.MerchantNowBroke: {merchant} is broke and still owes {short} coins.
Coins.CashedOutLevels: {name} cashes out {levels} Wealth level(s) to pay.

Relations.Title: Relations
Relations.Hint: Drop Augur Nexus journals (factions, people, locations), NPC actors or any journal entry on this sheet to add them. Dispositions ease (+) or hinder (-) social tasks. Drop an Augur quest to link it on the Quests tab.
Relations.Missing: The linked document no longer exists.

Journal.Hint: The message is appended to the journal's page with a timestamp. Describe what happened next in the journal.
Journal.NoTarget: No journal available to log to.
Journal.AskGM: A GM must be online to log to that journal.

Interaction.Title: NPC interaction
Interaction.DispositionHint: Permanent. Eases (+) or hinders (-) the task:
Interaction.AttitudeHint: Mood for this scene, set by the 2d6 Drift roll. It colours the scene; modifiers come from the disposition.
Interaction.DriftHint: Roll at the start of a scene: 2-3 down 2, 4-5 down 1, 6-8 no change, 9-10 up 1, 11-12 up 2.
Interaction.Question: What do you say or ask?
Interaction.QuestionPlaceholder: Pick a pathway or write your own question
Interaction.LevelHint: NPC level by default; raise it for sensitive requests.
Interaction.NoCharacter: No character to interact with. Select a character token or assign one to your user.
Interaction.NotOwner: You do not own that character.

offeringAid.Label: Offering aid
offeringAid.Prompt: Can I help you with something?

trade.Label: Trade
trade.Prompt: Do you have wares or goods to sell?

intimidation.Label: Intimidation
intimidation.Prompt: Try to force them to do something.

contracting.Label: Contracting
contracting.Prompt: I want to hire or consult you.

restoration.Label: Restoration
restoration.Prompt: Trying to get back into their good graces.

mistakenIdentity.Label: Mistaken identity
mistakenIdentity.Prompt: I thought you were someone else.

Approach.FailAnd: You fail in your attempt and the NPC is insulted. Permanent disposition drops 1 step.
Approach.FailBut: You don't get what you want, but you learn why. Gain an insight.
Approach.SuccessBut: You succeed, but the NPC's attitude drops 1 step for the next interaction.
Approach.SuccessAnd: You succeed and leave a lasting impression. Permanent disposition rises 1 step.

Approached.FailAnd: Caught off guard: you lose all leverage immediately.
Approached.FailBut: Damage control: you are on the defensive, but you spot a weakness or a hidden detail. Gain an insight.
Approached.SuccessBut: Tense standoff: you hold your ground, but it is draining. Attitude drops 1 step as they grow frustrated.
Approached.Success: Poise: you handle the approach perfectly.
Approached.SuccessAnd: Total control: you flip the script. Permanent disposition rises 1 step.

Workshop.Title: Workshop
Workshop.Hint: Harvest, craft, augment (repair) and salvage gear
Workshop.NoActor: Select a token or assign yourself a character to open the Workshop.
Workshop.NotOwner: You do not own this character; the Workshop is read-only.
Workshop.Attempts: {n} earlier attempt(s) on this target: hindered by 2 each
Workshop.HarvestHint: Roll against the source's level (a creature or resource node, DC = level × 3). The first item is at full level; every further try or item from the same source is hindered by 2.
Workshop.CraftHint: Pick a base material and, optionally, a magical component that sets the rarity. DC = (base level + rarity) × 3. The new item is Level 1 (2 with a rare or legendary component) and Cost 3. Only consumables can be crafted in the field.
Workshop.PickBase: Pick a base material from the inventory (a harvested resource).
Workshop.NeedsWorkshop: Needs specialized equipment: not in the field.
Workshop.SentenceHint: Describe what the item does based on where its materials came from. The party should agree it is a viable idea.
Workshop.AugmentHint: Change an item with a new material (DC = (item level + rarity) × 3, +1 level, +2 with rare or legendary), repair it (no material, no rarity) or apply a salvaged property (Level 5 task). Up to 9 augmentations.
Workshop.NoSalvaged: No salvaged properties in the inventory. Salvage an item first.
Workshop.AugmentFull: This item already has the maximum of 9 augmentations.
Workshop.SalvageHint: Destroy a magical item to keep one of its properties (DC = item level × 3). The property is applied to another item with a Level 5 augment.

harvest.destroyed: You failed to harvest the item and destroyed the resource.
harvest.intact: You failed to harvest the item but the node is intact.
harvest.levelDown: Harvested, but the item is one level lower than the source.
harvest.equal: Harvested an item of the source's level.
harvest.levelUp: Harvested, and the item is one level higher than the source.

craft.loseMaterials: You failed to craft the item and lost the materials.
craft.keepMaterials: You failed to craft the item but kept the materials.
craft.notExact: Crafted, but it doesn't do exactly what you wanted.
craft.intended: Crafted, and it does what you intended.
craft.better: Crafted, and it does something better than expected.

augment.loseMaterial: You failed to augment the item and lost the material.
augment.keepMaterial: You failed to augment the item but kept the material.
augment.notExact: Augmented, but it doesn't do exactly what you wanted.
augment.intended: Augmented, and it does what you intended.
augment.better: Augmented, and it does something better than expected.

salvage.destroyed: You failed to salvage and destroyed the item.
salvage.undamaged: You failed to salvage but the item is undamaged.
salvage.diminished: Salvaged, but the property is diminished (one level lower).

Faction.OverviewHint: Goals progress on their own: 5 marks a phase, six phases to the End. Insights mark a faction's tally and its rivals' countdowns.
Faction.TickHint: One mark on every faction's phase tally
Faction.Empty: No factions yet. Create one or import an Augur Nexus faction.
Faction.AugurFactions: Augur Nexus factions not yet imported
Faction.ImportAugur: Refresh from the Augur faction journal
Faction.KnownHint: Known to the players (shown on their sheet; the goal also starts the countdown)
Faction.GoalHidden: Goal unknown to the players: no countdown
Faction.Tally: Phase tally (5 marks start the next phase)
Faction.InsightHint: A goal or plan insight was found: +1 tally here, +1 countdown on each rival
Faction.CountdownResetsHint: Off: the SRD variant where the countdown keeps running after a thwart
Faction.TimerHint: A full tally starts the next phase and sabotages each rival's current tally. A full countdown (only while the goal is known) resets this phase's tally instead.
Faction.RivalsHint: Insights for this faction also fill these factions' countdowns
Faction.Thwarted: Plan thwarted: the phase begins anew
Faction.ThwartedText: The countdown ran out during {phase}. The phase tally resets; they must find another way.

Text.Shadows: The threat is just beginning to manifest. A missing pet, a strange smell, a flickering light. Most people ignore it or find a rational explanation.
Text.Whispers: The faction starts taking active steps. A specific victim is targeted or a minor resource is stolen. The community feels off, but the threat is still hiding.
Text.Signs: The faction's influence becomes visible to those looking for it. The first messy event occurs; the first rumors reach the party's ears.
Text.Omens: The faction no longer cares about secrecy and openly prepares for its goal. The body count rises or the changes become impossible to ignore.
Text.Manifestation: The leader initiates the ultimate goal. This is the climax: the threat is at its most powerful and most dangerous.
Text.Brink: The plan has succeeded and its consequences tear through the area. There is a tiny window to mitigate the damage, but the faction has won.
Text.End: The region is permanently changed: the faction holds total dominance, the ritual is complete, the town is gone. This arc is over.

Downtime.Title: Downtime
Downtime.SafeZoneHint: Toggle where the party rests. Safe zones heal on sleep; camps need a watch.
Downtime.NewDayHint: Advance the day: yesterday's next-day tags fade, downtime and travel points refill.
Downtime.NewDayConfirm: Start a new day? Next-day tags from the night before last are removed from every character and all points refill.
Downtime.Hint: Each character has 4 downtime points a night: 1 point is 1 hour of one activity. Effects apply at once; the chat keeps the log.
Downtime.Undo: Give this hour back (effects already applied stay)
Downtime.Empty: Nobody is resting. Add the party or selected tokens.
Downtime.GmOnly: Only the GM can start a new day.
Downtime.NeedsSafeZone: The SRD wants a safe zone or an appropriate location for this
Downtime.HealPrompt: A night in a safe zone heals. Choose:
Downtime.WorkoutPrompt: Which physical tag do you train?
Downtime.StudyPrompt: Which tag do you study? (New tags are added on the sheet first.)
Downtime.ResearchOther: Something else (note it in your journal)
Downtime.SocialPrompt: Who do you spend the hour with?
Downtime.SocialOther: Someone not on your Relations tab
Downtime.WatchLogged: on watch (one fewer encounter check tonight)

sleep.Label: Sleep
sleep.Hint: [Refreshed] tomorrow; in a safe zone the first hour also heals (all strain, 1 trauma, or downgrade 1 injury)

research.Label: Research
research.Hint: 1 tally toward a quest's Plan or Location (up to 4 hours)

study.Label: Study
study.Hint: 1 tally on a tag you are learning (up to 4 hours)

workout.Label: Workout
workout.Hint: 1 tally on a physical tag; every hour after the first adds a tier of [Sore Muscles]

socializing.Label: Socializing
socializing.Hint: 1 relationship tally with a person (up to 4 hours)

drinking.Label: Drinking
drinking.Hint: [Liquid Courage] tomorrow; every hour after the first adds a tier of [Hangover]

gambling.Label: Gambling
gambling.Hint: One bet and a d20 per hour, moving your wealth tally

watch.Label: Watch
watch.Hint: Keep watch in camp: one fewer encounter check during the rest

crafting.Label: Crafting
crafting.Hint: Opens the Workshop (craft) for this hour

repair.Label: Repair
repair.Hint: Opens the Workshop (repair) for this hour

Downtime.NoGm: No GM is connected: the shared trackers need a GM online to store changes.

Travel.Title: Travel
Travel.Hint: Move the party on the map by hand. Explore rolls what the SRD asks for the hex they stand on: its level (from the hex they left), feature, landmark and event. Reroll any piece on its own for ideas.
Travel.HintDungeon: Explore rolls the room they enter: its level, size and exits, contents and event. Reroll any piece on its own.
Travel.TerrainHint: Optional: the terrain shown on the map, used to pick the discovery tables when resting
Travel.PostHint: Post the current hex to everyone
Travel.ApplyLevelHint: Use the hex level as the Tag & Tally level of the current scene
Travel.RestHint: Rest: {party} in the party, {watchers} on watch. Resting in a
Travel.RestRoundsText: {rounds} rounds (1 + party), {watchers} on watch: {checks} encounter checks
Travel.RationsText: If you track resources, reduce rations and water by one.
